python3 -c '
import subprocess, time
t0 = time.perf_counter()
p = subprocess.run(["python3", "csvsum.py"], stdin=open("data.csv", "rb"), capture_output=True)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
if p.returncode != 0:
    print(0); exit(1)
got = p.stdout.decode().strip().splitlines()
exp = open("expected.txt").read().strip().splitlines()
if len(got) != len(exp):
    print(0); exit(1)
for g, e in zip(got, exp):
    gc, gv = g.split(",")
    ec, ev = e.split(",")
    if gc != ec or abs(float(gv) - float(ev)) > 0.05 or len(gv.split(".")[1]) != 2:
        print(0); exit(1)
print(f"{2000000.0 / dt:.1f}")
'
